readings.title: GetModuleNamespace ( module: an instance of a concrete subclass of Module Record, phase: defer or evaluation, ): a Module Namespace Object

sentence.text: If _phase_ is ~defer~, let _namespace_ be _module_.[[DeferredNamespace]]. Else, let _namespace_ be _module_.[[Namespace]].

reading.text: 1. If _phase_ is ~defer~, let _namespace_ be _module_.[[DeferredNamespace]]; else let _namespace_ be _module_.[[Namespace]].

note: The two sentences of the step are one conditional: _namespace_ is the [[DeferredNamespace]] field for ~defer~ and the [[Namespace]] field otherwise.
readings.why: an inline conditional written as two sentences. The text writes "…; else let …" everywhere else

sentence.text: For each Module Record _dep_ of _evaluationList_, append _dep_.Evaluate() to _asyncDepsEvaluationPromises_.

reading.text:
1. For each Module Record _dep_ of _evaluationList_, do
  1. Append _dep_.Evaluate() to _asyncDepsEvaluationPromises_.

note: The loop's body written as a step of its own: in order, each module's Evaluate() is called and its Promise appended.

readings.title: Evaluate ( ): a Promise

sentence.text: Assert: None of _module_ or any of its recursive dependencies have [[Status]] set to ~evaluating~, ~linking~, ~unlinked~, or ~new~.

reading.text:
1. Let _pending_ be « _module_ ».
1. Let _seen_ be a new empty List.
1. Repeat, while _pending_ is not empty,
  1. Let _m_ be the first element of _pending_.
  1. Remove the first element from _pending_.
  1. If _seen_ does not contain _m_ and _m_ is a Cyclic Module Record, then
    1. Append _m_ to _seen_.
    1. Assert: _m_.[[Status]] is one of ~linked~, ~evaluating-async~, or ~evaluated~.
    1. For each ModuleRequest Record _request_ of _m_.[[RequestedModules]], do
      1. Append GetImportedModule(_m_, _request_) to _pending_.

note: The text does not define "recursive dependencies"; the reading takes them as the modules reached from _module_ through [[RequestedModules]] and GetImportedModule, the way InnerModuleEvaluation walks them (§16.2.1.6.1.3.1, step 11), each once. [[Status]] is one of ~new~, ~unlinked~, ~linking~, ~linked~, ~evaluating~, ~evaluating-async~ and ~evaluated~ (a table of §16.2.1.6), so "not ~evaluating~, ~linking~, ~unlinked~, or ~new~" is the other three. Only a Cyclic Module Record has a [[Status]]; a module of another kind has no dependencies to walk. The walk asks GetImportedModule only of a module whose [[Status]] is not ~new~ or ~unlinked~, whose requests have all been loaded.
readings.why: "recursive dependencies" is defined nowhere. There is no model operation for it, so this is the one new loop

readings.title: GetImportedModule ( referrer: a Cyclic Module Record, request: a ModuleRequest Record, ): a Module Record

sentence.text: Let _records_ be a List consisting of each LoadedModuleRequest Record _r_ of _referrer_.[[LoadedModules]] such that ModuleRequestsKeyEqual(_r_, _request_) is *true*.

reading.text:
1. Let _records_ be a new empty List.
1. For each LoadedModuleRequest Record _r_ of _referrer_.[[LoadedModules]], do
  1. If ModuleRequestsKeyEqual(_r_, _request_) is *true*, append _r_ to _records_.

note: The List keeps the order of _referrer_.[[LoadedModules]]; step 2 asserts it has one element.
readings.why: the rename changed the step's hash, so the reading lost its anchor

readings.title: EvaluateImportCall ( args: a Parse Node, phase: defer or evaluation, ): either a normal completion containing a Promise or an abrupt completion

sentence.text: Sort _attrs_ according to the lexicographic order of their [[Key]] field, treating the value of each such field as a sequence of UTF-16 code unit values. NOTE: This sorting is observable only in that hosts are prohibited from changing behaviour based on the order in which attributes are enumerated.

reading.text:
1. Let _rest_ be a copy of _attrs_.
1. Let _sorted_ be a new empty List.
1. Repeat, while _rest_ is not empty,
  1. Let _least_ be the first element of _rest_.
  1. For each element _a_ of _rest_, do
    1. If ! IsLessThan(_a_.[[Key]], _least_.[[Key]], *true*) is *true*, set _least_ to _a_.
  1. Append _least_ to _sorted_.
  1. Remove _least_ from _rest_.
1. Set _attrs_ to _sorted_.

note: Lexicographic order of sequences of UTF-16 code units is IsLessThan's order on Strings (§7.2.12, step 3). The [[Key]] fields are distinct, so each step's least element is unique. _attrs_ is not shared, so its sorted copy replaces it.
This sorting is observable only in that hosts are prohibited from changing behaviour based on the order in which attributes are enumerated.

sentence.text: Create an own data property of _namespace_ named %Symbol.toStringTag% whose [[Value]] is _toStringTag_ and whose [[Writable]], [[Enumerable]], and [[Configurable]] attributes are *false*.

errata.title: Static Semantics: BoundNames ( ): a List of Strings
note: The proposal adds the production ImportDeclaration : `import` `defer` NameSpaceImport FromClause WithClause? `;` to §16.2.2 and gives it rows of ModuleRequests and ImportEntries, but none of BoundNames, and the production is not a chain production. Every |Module| with an `import defer` asks for it before it runs: the early errors of ModuleItem : ImportDeclaration ("the BoundNames of |ImportDeclaration|") and of |ModuleItemList| (its LexicallyDeclaredNames, which are the BoundNames of each |ImportDeclaration|). So the literal text stops every such module at its early errors. The literal text, a row that is not there, is not a reading the notation can write, so the erratum has one reading (layer none). The test262 and proposed reading: the row is the twin of ImportClause : NameSpaceImport's, the one name the namespace import binds (test262's language/import/import-defer tests bind it).

errata.title: CreateDefaultExportSyntheticModule ( defaultExport: an ECMAScript language value, ): a Synthetic Module Record
note: The proposal adds [[DeferredNamespace]] to the fields of every Module Record (a table of §16.2.1.5) and initialises it in ParseModule, but not in CreateDefaultExportSyntheticModule, which makes every JSON module's record: read literally, the record has no [[DeferredNamespace]], and GetModuleNamespace(_module_, ~defer~) reads a field the record lacks (`import defer * as ns from "./x.json" with { type: "json" }`). The test262 and proposed reading: the field is ~empty~, as [[Namespace]] is (test262's language/import/import-defer/deferred-namespace-object/json-module.js).
